dataset: Fraunhofer Twin House N2, IEA EBC Annex 71 main experiment, version 161.2
period_selection: All rows in N2 exp1 full1 10min; no selection by prediction error

split.method: ordered contiguous rows; floors applied to first two sizes; no shuffle

fit_loss: sum of squared training one-step errors of interval-mean temperature, in degC
model: 1R1C with positive H and C; actual resistive-heater input plus measured IHS; nonnegative bounded window-solar term; no fitted constant gains
observation: floor-area-weighted mean of ten measured room-centre air-temperature channels; spatial aggregation is explicitly derived
sampling: source values are 10-minute averages, not instantaneous temperatures; exact interval-mean observation equation is used
clock: fixed Central European winter time UTC+1 throughout; equal DATE labels must join exactly
bin_label: end-labelled intervals inferred from first timestamp 18:10 versus experimental start 18:00; exact averaging-window placement is not explicitly stated by publisher
heating_semantics: room electric heater and IHS channels summed, W converted to kW; combined heater/IHS split is publisher-calculated in some rooms; their sum restores total measured input; electric-to-room heat conversion factor 1 is a declared model assumption
solar_reference: maximum of measured global and four vertical facade irradiances, divided by 1000 to kW/m2; does not claim measured transmitted solar gain
solar_upper_bound_basis: Specification Figure 9 and Table 2: six type-1 windows + one each type-2/3/4/5; glazing = 6*1.29+1.84+4.11+0.90+2.18 = 16.77 m2; normal-incidence SHGC upper assumption 0.62 from manufacturer figure in section 3.5; effective area <=16.77*0.62. Opaque solar absorption is omitted and remains model discrepancy.
H_C_bound_identity: broad analyst positive bounds, not source measurements or Wuhan values
model_selection: one declared structure; deterministic starts chosen only by training SSE; validation and test never used for parameter fitting or selection
baseline: temperature persistence with the same initialization/information pattern as the corresponding prediction mode
source_limitations: Publisher filled unspecified short measurement failures by linear interpolation for temperatures and zero for powers/flows, without row-level quality flags; these cannot be removed or distinguished here.
O5 simulated December power refill is excluded by selecting N2 only.

N2 is a multiroom heavy building with ventilation, internal door/window changes, ground/attic effects and omitted fan heat; one time-invariant RC is an applicability test, not a complete physical reconstruction.
Recorded future weather and heat inputs are used: this is conditional prediction, not a deployable weather/control forecast.
No external parameter or fitted value will replace Wuhan synthetic parameters.
